q: What are SIDBI's risk sharing facilities for electric vehicles and solid waste projects?
title: SIDBI EV and waste risk sharing
short: Both are partial credit guarantees, not loans to you. Under the Electric Vehicle Risk Sharing Facility SIDBI shares part of the credit risk of lenders financing electric two and three wheelers. A separate facility covers lending for municipal solid waste management. You borrow from the lender; SIDBI shares that lender's loss.
audience: EV fleet operators, aggregators, waste management firms and their lenders

sections.h: How a risk sharing facility works
p: The facility sits between SIDBI and a bank or NBFC. If an eligible borrower defaults, SIDBI absorbs part of the lender's loss. The lender is then more willing to lend to a segment it sees as risky, such as electric three wheelers whose resale value is uncertain. You still owe the full loan.

SIDBI describes the EV facility as a partial credit guarantee arrangement meant to improve the flow of finance to electric mobility. It also says fleet operators and aggregators seeking finance for electric vehicles can contact SIDBI directly under its EV lending initiative, which is separate from the guarantee.
SIDBI lists a Risk Sharing Facility for Municipal Solid Waste Management among its green finance products. It works the same way, covering part of a lender's exposure on waste projects.
